data.one_liner: AI chat widgets and LLM provider integration for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of AI chat-related widgets to easily add an AI chat window supporting multi-turn chat, streaming responses, voice input, and multimedia attachments to a Flutter app. It uses an abstract LLM provider API with built-in support for Firebase AI.
use_when: You want to add an AI chat interface to your mobile, desktop, or web Flutter app.
You are using Firebase AI / Gemini as your LLM backend.
You need built-in support for voice input, rich text, and multimedia attachments in chat.
avoid_when: You are not using Firebase or need an LLM provider not supported by the abstract API.
You need low-level model access without any prebuilt UI chat widgets.
strengths: Multi-turn chat and real-time streaming responses out of the box.
Supports text, image, and voice input along with file attachments.
Cross-platform support for Android, iOS, web, and macOS.
weaknesses: Requires a Firebase project and setup for its primary out-of-the-box provider.
API key support for certain direct providers has been dropped in favor of Firebase projects.
data.setup_notes: Requires initializing Firebase using flutterfire config, adding platform network access permissions for macOS/Android, and configuring microphone and media picker permissions.
